This source is a coverage guide only and does not contain the full text of the Berkeley rent stabilization and eviction for just cause ordinance. Specific requirement percentages, interest rates, and detailed just cause grounds are not provided in this document.

The document does not provide effective dates for the ordinance; the current status (in_force) assumes these protections are currently operative, but the source does not state when they became effective.

Golden Duplexes (owner-occupied as of December 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied), units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant (and the owner lived there when tenancy started), tenancies started after November 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied, university rental units, and nonprofit cooperatives are all exempt from all ordinance coverage.

The table note indicates units with Housing Choice Voucher, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, California Community Housing Agency, HOME, City of Berkeley Housing Trust Fund, and Mental Health Safety Act are included in 'fully covered' categories, while Rental Supplement Program and Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside are only covered if the project does NOT have an HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage.
